profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer & Architect | 20+ years building enterprise SaaS, analytics & cloud platforms | Agentic AI, MCP & distributed systems | Hands-on technical leadership from architecture through delivery
profile.summary: Principal software engineer and architect with 20+ years of experience designing and building enterprise SaaS, analytics, cloud, and integration platforms. Hands-on technical leader bridging product strategy, software architecture, security, and engineering delivery. Recently architected and led development of an agentic AI analytics platform and secure Model Context Protocol (MCP) platform, enabling conversational data exploration, autonomous AI workflows, and integration with external AI assistants.

positions.title: System Specialist
positions.description: Developed key components of an AWS-hosted enterprise platform for ingesting, processing, searching, and managing millions of music-repertoire submissions, including AngularJS and Django interfaces, Java/JAX-RS services, Solr search, and pipelines supporting DDEX, proprietary, text, and Excel formats.

positions.title: Locator
positions.description: Designed the application infrastructure for a public detainee-search platform supporting nine languages, right-to-left layouts, extensible CAPTCHA providers, declarative service caching, and a continuous-integration and quality pipeline built with Spring, Struts, JAX-WS, Maven, Hudson, Cobertura, PMD, and SiteMesh.

positions.title: Information Management Specialist
positions.description: Architected a reusable dynamic-form and PDF-generation framework, modernized the legacy Java application with Spring and Hibernate, and reduced the full automated test suite from approximately 80 minutes to under four minutes while establishing stronger code-review and quality standards.

positions.title: Around the Corner Hunger
positions.description: Architected and developed an AWS-hosted public donation and hunger-awareness platform featuring interactive donation workflows, Google Maps–based state hunger visualizations, reusable Java/Spring/Hibernate components, automated testing, and cloud integrations across EC2, ELB, RDS, S3, and CloudFront.

positions.title: Niagara Metering Gateway
positions.description: Developed a major release of an energy-monitoring platform, designing configurable charts and gauges, a runtime visualization-discovery framework, and a dashboard for viewing building and metering data.

positions.title: Web Application Specialist
positions.description: Deployed and configured WebXM application-security scanning environments for government and enterprise clients, including NIH, American Express, HHS, and the National Park Service.

positions.title: Controller
positions.description: Enhanced and supported a mission-critical command-and-control system and developed an Office of Naval Research prototype integrating the platform with Surface Acoustic Wave RFID technology.

positions.title: Application Specialist
positions.description: Developed reusable data-access, Excel report-generation, and JAX-WS integration frameworks—including a NIEM-compliant service and schema—while mentoring junior engineers on Java development, testing, and maintainable application design.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Architected and led development of Luma, Decile’s agentic AI analytics platform, enabling users to explore customer data conversationally through a custom text-to-SQL agent querying Snowflake, generate interactive visualizations and presentations, and manage their work in a shared, versioned library. Extended Luma with proactive background agents that use persistent memory and recent activity to surface personalized insights and follow-ups. Developed infrastructure for prompt caching, model cost accounting, agent tracing, and debugging. Technologies: Python, Django, LangChain, Anthropic, Celery, AG-UI, A2UI, Arize Phoenix.

- Architected and built Decile’s Model Context Protocol (MCP) platform, securely exposing customer-intelligence capabilities to AI assistants such as ChatGPT and Claude through OAuth 2.1 authorization, granular permissions, and interactive MCP applications..

- Modernized cloud infrastructure and application delivery by migrating legacy services to Kubernetes and GitOps, introducing preview and canary environments that enable developers and business users to rapidly prototype, test, and deploy changes using AI agents in isolated test environments.

- Served as application and frontend architect for Decile’s enterprise SaaS products, leading developers and establishing architecture, authorization models, SSO integrations, API conventions, and engineering standards. Designed and developed analytics platforms supporting large-scale data exploration, configurable dashboards, advanced visualizations, and Looker integration.

positions.title: Code Slinger
positions.description: Built cloud-hosted server and client features, responsive content and advertising widgets, a reusable cross-domain JavaScript library, and a modular build, testing, and deployment system targeting Amazon S3 and CloudFront.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Developed full-stack product features for Trove's consumer content platform, including its commenting system, homepage, and other core user-facing functionality.

● Improved single-page application performance by designing and implementing a route-based code-splitting framework that reduced the amount of JavaScript loaded for each page.

● Contributed to open-source development tooling, including adding CoffeeScript support to the Karma JavaScript test runner.

projects.title: Decile MCP
projects.description:
Connect Decile
to your AI.
The Decile MCP brings your customer intelligence into Claude — and any other MCP-enabled assistant. Explore your Personas, build Audiences, and ask questions about your data, right inside the chat.

https://mcp.decile.com
